items.bio_en: Prof. Cheolmin Park seeks to utilize the molecular self-assembly principles found in Nature to create and control new nanometer scale soft and hybrid materials for innovative electrical devices based on emerging nanotechnology. The research interest covers from molecular design, assembly to nanopatterns and devices including self-organizing polymer systems and nanostructures, with particular emphasis on functional block copolymers, supra-molecular assembled materials and hybrid assembly of carbon nanomaterials with polymers; solution-processed non-lithographic printing technologies such as nanoimprinting, ink-jet and transfer printing combined with surface engineering; various organic and polymeric devices such as ultrahigh density ferroelectric polymer memories, organic field effect transistors, solar cells and novel electroluminescent devices with networked carbon nanomaterials. The goal is to contribute to the understanding of process-structure-property relationships and to create technologically useful materials and devices.

items.title: 真实世界中的大语言模型安全
items.abstract: 随着大语言模型日益融入真实世界的各类应用，仅依靠基准测试已无法充分理解其安全性。本报告围绕大语言模型安全，探讨模型在真实场景中遭受攻击及被滥用的问题。首先，分析攻击者如何利用越狱攻击绕过模型内置的安全防护；随后，讨论非自愿性色情内容生成和人工智能辅助传播网络仇恨等滥用现象及其社会风险；最后，关注商业化虚假模型与欺骗性人工智能服务的出现，以及它们对模型透明度、生态可信性和用户信任带来的挑战。

items.title: 大规模超智融合科学应用的进展与挑战
items.abstract: 大规模科学计算应用正在从“超算”走向“超智融合”时代。本报告希望和大家交流我们在地学领域的大规模超智融合科学应用研制上的进展与问题，以及碰到或预见的挑战。

items.title: Inferring Dynamic Cellular Processes from Single-Cell Omics Data
items.abstract: Single-cell omics technologies are now widely used to study cellular heterogeneity and dynamics in biomedical research. When cells sampled from a population represent different states along a continuous biological process, pseudotime and trajectory inference methods are commonly applied to reconstruct the underlying progression from transcriptomic variation. However, most existing trajectory methods are designed for single-sample analyses and do not naturally extend to comparisons across multiple samples or to the analysis of longitudinal data. In addition, many approaches rely on heuristic assumptions and have limited ability to infer directionality or quantify uncertainty in dynamic processes. In this talk, I will present our recent work addressing these limitations. First, I will introduce a statistical machine learning method for inferring and comparing cellular trajectories across multiple samples, enabling principled cross-condition and cross-subject comparisons. I will then describe a model-based approach for analyzing dynamic cellular processes using longitudinal single-cell immune profiling data, which explicitly captures state transitions, directionality, and temporal evolution. Together, these tools provide a rigorous statistical framework for studying dynamic cellular processes in complex single-cell datasets.

items.title: 具身智能的理论探微与技术突围
items.abstract: 传统机器学习旨在从样本中学习静态信息（如标签或聚类结果），这一范式在具身智能领域面临根本性挑战。具身智能更加关注智能体动作生成，而动作的实施会直接改变智能体作业的环境状态，进而影响后续数据的采集，从而导致了机器学习核心的“独立同分布”假设在机器人应用中失效。由此，本报告首先指出了具身智能不同与传统的机器学习，它面对的是非平稳过程人工智能。接着，讨论了机器人在物理世界的学习过程中，面临着三重相互关联的非平稳性挑战，即由策略演化引发的数据分布非平稳、由物理交互导致的环境动力学非平稳，以及由跨智能体差异引起的域偏移非平稳，本报告给出了处理三种非平稳的强化学习理论方法。其次，讨论了非平稳强化学习的应用。最后，展望了具身理论的未来发展和学科体系。

items.title: The Social Structure of Scientific Evaluation: The Past, Present, and Future of Benchmarking
items.abstract: Evaluation systems in science do more than assess past work—they shape the future direction of research. Most scientific fields are primarily organized around "organic" evaluation systems (e.g., peer review, citation) that holistically weigh contributions across multiple epistemic values. However, artificial intelligence (AI) has diverged sharply from this model. Drawing on interviews, computational analyses, and archival materials spanning AI's history (1956–2021), this paper examines how AI evolved from a fragmented discipline with weak organic evaluation into a field driven by benchmarking—a "formal" evaluation system that defines progress quantitatively as accuracy on commercial tasks. Benchmarking rewarded raw accuracy, which large-scale deep learning was uniquely positioned to deliver. Yet this success came at a cost: benchmarking's narrow focus discouraged the development of alternative technologies that could address deep learning's limitations (e.g., theoretical opacity, inefficiency, low interpretability), fostering an "epistemic monoculture." At the same time, deep learning's opacity made organic evaluation increasingly difficult, further entrenching benchmarking as the field's dominant evaluative institution. We discuss how the spread of AI technologies will bring benchmarking's influence into other disciplines (and domains of social life). While this shift will undoubtedly transform sciences from biology to sociology, AI's success raises a deeper question: is organic evaluation an essential feature of science?

items.title: 从AI研究到AI产品：创新创业的落地实践与思考
items.abstract:
大语言模型的爆发让"人人都能做AI产品"成为可能，但也让一个问题愈发清晰：技术已经不再是最大的瓶颈。
本次讲座分享一位横跨AI研究、教学与创业的学者的真实经历与观察。主讲人将从十余年的在线平台、用户行为、游戏化机制与AI辅助学习研究出发，讲述如何将学术积累转化为真实产品，以及在这一过程中对"研究逻辑与用户现实之间张力"的切身体会。
讲座最后将分享对美国AI创业生态的一手观察：大学创业支持体系的运转机制（以明尼苏达大学为例）、教授如何走向创业，以及一个越来越清晰的趋势——真正能落地的AI创新，往往不是来自最强的模型，而是来自对特定场景和用户的深度理解。

items.title: Surrogate-Model Approaches to Optimizers for LLM Training
items.abstract: The recent empirical success of the Muon optimizer in training large language models has outpaced the theoretical understanding of its matrix-gradient orthogonalization design. To bridge this gap, this talk introduces surrogate-model approaches that analyze and systematically improve deep learning optimization over a single iteration. We first present the isotropic curvature model, a convex program assuming curvature isotropy across perturbation directions, which reveals that optimal update matrices achieve a more homogeneous spectrum. This approach demonstrates that while Muon's gradient orthogonalization is directionally correct, it is only strictly optimal under specific curvature phase transitions. Building upon this theoretical foundation, we introduce a second quadratic surrogate model that approximates the loss using the gradient, an output-space curvature matrix, and the input data matrix. By minimizing this surrogate under an isotropic weight assumption, we derive Newton-Muon. This finding implies that standard Muon is an implicit Newton-type method that neglects the right preconditioning induced by the input second moment. Empirically, Newton-Muon accelerates GPT-2 pretraining, reaching target validation loss in 6% fewer iteration steps and reducing wall-clock training time by roughly 4%, illustrating the efficacy of principled surrogate models in designing LLM optimizers. This is based on arXiv:2511.00674 and 2604.01472.

items.title: 从深度学习到大模型 -- Lessons and Insights from History
items.abstract: 回顾深度学习注意力机制的发展，揭示逐步模型结构向系统转变的趋势，提出把模型结构当做系统设计的思路。回顾梯度成为机器学习的核心的历程，揭示当今对大模型后训练中的梯度已经脱离了对目标求导的框架，提出全空间梯度设计和梯度动力学控制的新思路，再次通过系统构建来解决轨迹选择问题。这些讨论，从历史中吸取教训和得到启发，也揭示了系统构建对模型结构和机器学习的深远影响。

items.title: 大模型后训练系统构建和算法实践
items.abstract: 本讲座结合大模型后训练实践，从 AI 基础设施视角介绍如何把训练、推理、数据和云原生平台组织成稳定闭环：训练侧支撑万亿级模型、长上下文和稀疏专家负载，推理侧快速接收新权重并稳定服务，数据侧统一记录对话、工具调用和评测轨迹，平台侧负责 GPU 调度、模型服务、观测评测和高并发 rollout，让算法探索具备可复现、可扩展的工程底座。
